d: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?
Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

Dogs are not only man's best friend, they can also serve as therapists. “Cute Pet Guide” help you train your dog to become a therapy dog. Aside from canned dog food, owners can be more attentive and prepare sumptuous meals for their pets through chef video tutorials. “Cute Pet Guide” will present you and your furry babies with exquisite dishes of love!

Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond
